rows.newResearch: Current official RCW text independently preserves that distinction. Subsection (1) supplies administrative review and specified follow-up; subsection (2) supplies immediate sealing after qualifying acquittal/dismissal with prejudice, subject to appeal and its deferred-disposition exception. Subsection (3) motion and subsection (5) motion notice are not substitutes for this family.
rows.instrument: Court's written administrative or immediate sealing order; participant receives an actionable status/verification guide, not a petition, motion, or pre-completed judicial order.
rows.filingActor: Court initiates and enters the order. Participant presence at an administrative sealing hearing is not required. Probation/juvenile department performs statutory restitution follow-up; participant may supply proof of payment and request an administrative hearing after that condition is satisfied, without converting this family into a JU motion route.
rows.destination: Juvenile court holding the offender case; named local juvenile department for the subsection (1)(f) restitution-payment follow-up. Contact details must come from the actual case/court rather than a guessed statewide mailing address.
rows.trigger: Applicable subsection (1) cohort reaches its scheduled administrative review after the latest relevant age-18, supervision and confinement/parole events; excluded most-serious, sex, and specified drug offenses do not become eligible by this guide. Separately, subsection (2) qualifying acquittal after fact-finding or dismissal with prejudice triggers immediate court action, subject to statutory exceptions and appeal.
rows.timingDeadline: Administrative hearing is scheduled at the first regularly scheduled hearing after the latest statutory event. If supervision remains, continue within 30 days after anticipated completion. On unpaid individual-victim restitution, written denial identifies the amount; department notification is due within five business days. No participant filing deadline for a new motion is imported. Immediate subsection (2) sealing remains subject to the State's appeal right.
requiredComponents: Case-specific status guide identifying the court, case number, applicable court-initiated trigger and how to obtain/verify the actual sealing order
For restitution follow-up, actual written denial/balance and participant payment proof when applicable
Record of actual court/department contact and response, not a fabricated certification that the record is sealed
rows.feesWaivers: This treatment initiates no participant court filing and therefore quotes no filing fee or filing-fee waiver. That does not establish that copies, records requests or any separate proceeding are free.
rows.noticeService: Court/department notice in subsections (1)-(2) controls. Do not require the reasonable-notice-to-prosecutor-and-record-agencies package prescribed for a subsection (3) motion. The guide does not certify completed notice or service.
rows.exactSelfHelpStop: Excluded offense/cohort, contested eligibility or restitution, appealed order, denial outside the bounded administrative-payment follow-up, or a requested participant motion requires a separately supported professional/route handoff. A missing public-record change is not proof of noncompliance or permission to file JU 10.0300 automatically. First obtain the actual court status/order and the recorded reason for any delay.

rows.destination: Court that decided the case, district or justice as applicable. rows.newResearch: All six retained source pages were text-read and locally rendered/inspected for identity, edition and actor ownership. Both PDFs are flat and unencrypted, with zero AcroForm widgets; an AcroForm-only builder cannot fill them. 1001EXF separates conviction/nonconviction allegations and requests an actual special-certificate number plus participant-authored eligibility/public-interest explanations. 1021EXF contains judicial clear-and-convincing findings; protecting only the judge's signature is insufficient. The source's repeated paragraph number on the order is issuer text, not permission to silently alter the blank source.
